correspondents: President Porfirio Díaz; Rafael Chousal; Ignacio M. Escudero; Felipe Berriozábal; Blas Escontría; J. Y. Limantour → Gen. Bernardo Reyes (Monterrey)
place: Mexico City (one from Cuernavaca, one from San Luis Potosí)
folio_note: One telegram each; the catalogue lists 52 untranslated cipher records in fondo DLI (list in cehm_sintraduccion.json), about 2,100 records typed "telegrama cifrado" in all, most with summaries
status: CEHM records read "Sin traducción" / "[Legajo sin traducción]" with type "Telegrama cifrado"; hundreds of sibling Díaz-Reyes cipher telegrams in the same fondo carry summaries of their content, so a key can be rebuilt from translated pairs.
